entity.summary: Japan-based centralized exchange that ceased operations in 2014 after an insolvency-related collapse.
entity.notes: Official dates split: civil rehabilitation application filed 2014-02-28; bankruptcy proceedings commenced 2014-04-24.

events.title: Mt. Gox applied for civil rehabilitation in Tokyo
events.description: MtGox Co., Ltd. applied to the Tokyo District Court for commencement of civil rehabilitation proceedings (minji saisei) on February 28, 2014, and the application was accepted the same day. The company reported that approximately 750,000 customer bitcoins and approximately 100,000 of its own bitcoins had disappeared, and that liabilities of about JPY 6.5 billion exceeded assets of about JPY 3.84 billion. The court issued preservation, comprehensive prohibition, and supervisory orders. The application was later dismissed on April 16, 2014, and bankruptcy proceedings commenced on April 24, 2014.
events.notes: This filing is the 2014-02-28 marker already referenced by the entity record (death_date and notes). It is distinct from the April 24, 2014 commencement of bankruptcy proceedings recorded in the canonical base events.

evidence.title: Announcement Regarding an Application for Commencement of a Procedure of Civil Rehabilitation
evidence.notes: First-party announcement of the February 28, 2014 civil rehabilitation application to the Tokyo District Court, including the reported missing bitcoin amounts and the asset and liability figures.

evidence.title: Report under Article 157 of the Bankruptcy Act
evidence.notes: Trustee report to the Tokyo District Court confirming the February 28, 2014 civil rehabilitation application (2014 (rehabilitation) No. 12), its April 16, 2014 dismissal, and the April 24, 2014 commencement of bankruptcy proceedings.
